crossRefs.note: Elisha said to him, “Take bow and arrows;” and he took bow and arrows for himself.

translations.web: Elisha said to him, “Take bow and arrows;” and he took bow and arrows for himself.
translations.bsb: Elisha told him, “Take a bow and some arrows.” So Jehoash took a bow and some arrows.
translations.kjv: And Elisha said unto him, Take bow and arrows. And he took unto him bow and arrows.
translations.asv: And Elisha said unto him, Take bow and arrows; and he took unto him bow and arrows.
